name: Cable Shrug
cues: Clip a straight bar to the bottom pulley and stand close to the machine
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs with straight arms
Shrug straight up and pause at the top
Lower slowly until your shoulders sink fully

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: Shrug DOFs match 314 (clavicle elevation -3 to 26 deg, elbow 13). The pulley at (0, 0.08, 0.5) pulls about 31 deg from vertical, so the body leans back (COM z -0.117 vs -0.065 on 314), which is plausible. The cable clears the shins (z 0.24 at knee height vs knee -0.08). Tower top is cropped and the trap highlight is small. The 'bar_stack' implement id is a workaround for the missing attachment param.
